titles.title: Recycling Infrastructure and Data Accountability Act
Recycling Infrastructure and Data Accountability Act

To direct the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency to conduct a study on the feasibility of establishing a standardized national database for tracking recyclable materials, recycling infrastructure capacity, material recovery outcomes, landfill diversion, geographic areas with limited access to recycling collection services and processing facilities, and extended producer responsibility program performance, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.
